english.title: Pilot / tug driver involved in aircraft accident failed to stop and report accident - Liverpool Airport
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) on part of Liverpool John Lennon Airport to which the road traffic enactments did not apply, namely **(..SPECIFY THE LOCATION..), being the

(A)_[pilot in command of an aircraft, namely **(..SPECIFY AIRCRAFT..), present at the time]_
(B)_[tug-driver towing an aircraft, namely **(..SPECIFY AIRCRAFT..),]_

when an accident occurred involving the aircraft, failed to stop and give your name and address, the name and address of the operator of the aircraft, its identifying marks, and details of the accident to a constable, airport official or a person having reasonable grounds for requiring them, as soon as reasonably practicable, and in any event, no later than 24 hours after the accident
english.legislation: Contrary to byelaws 2(1)(c) and 8(3)(a) of the Liverpool John Lennon Airport Byelaws 2022.
